name: WV spill and accidental discharge reporting rule (Cornell LII: W. Va. Code R. § 46-03-2)
legal_basis: W. Va. Code R. § 46-03-2 (as numbered on LII)
status_reason: Immediate report to the DEP emergency number (1-800-642-3074) by 'each and every person who may cause or be responsible for any spill or accidental discharge of pollutants', including sewage; no public notice.
notes: Fetched via WebFetch (summary); exact WV CSR series number in the current Secretary of State code not confirmed.

name: WV HB 3217 (2025): public notification of environmental spills
access_detail: Introduced bill text read 2026-11-03 (not kept in raw/ because it lists sponsors by name).
status_reason: Would have made DEP give public notice within 24 hours of any reported spill 'of any hazardous substance, sewage, or other pollutants' and keep an online spill database; introduced 2025-03-07, referred to Energy and Public Works; no passage found.
notes: Quote (a): "The West Virginia Department of Environmental Protection ('DEP') shall provide public notification within 24 hours of any reported spill, discharge, or release of any hazardous substance, sewage, or other pollutants into the waters of the state"; (f): "The DEP shall publish and maintain an online public database tracking all spills".
